mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading highlights the 27° central angle between the radii. Right image: The shading designates the entire planar rectangle whose area is specified by its side lengths.
Rationales: The feature highlights the angle between two rays in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The lavender wedge at the right-hand junction of the two radii. The orange interior of the rectangle labeled 1 yd by 2 yd.
